protocol.description: Multi-product Solana AMM and DEX. Operates four pool models: Standard AMM v4 (constant-product + OpenBook CLOB integration), CLMM (concentrated liquidity), CPMM (revamped constant-product with Token-2022 support), and Stable (Curve-style stableswap). Secondary products include LaunchLab (IDO launchpad) and Burn & Earn (permanent liquidity locker). Launched February 2021; experienced a December 2022 admin-key-compromise ($4.4M loss) and subsequently migrated to Squads V4 multisig admin with 24-hour timelock.
